The '''Defense Weapon EDWX-843''', commonly known as the '''droid disabler''', was an anti-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon manufactured by [[Mandroxan Exports]]. It fired a beam of phased energy particles which were attracted to the droid's own mass, building up on the exterior. The charge disrupted the droid's internal electronics and neural patterns.
